**Finding: deviation (MINCOMMIT) — § 2.1**

§ 2.1 is the playbook walk-away case: a three-year, USD 2,000,000-per-year take-or-pay commitment on us, expressly "without reduction or termination rights." It also contradicts three customer-favourable clauses elsewhere in the document — § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment), § 9.4 (unconditional 30-day convenience termination with refund of prepaid Fees), and § 7.1 (no unidentified minimum-use charges).

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted at the preferred level: § 2.1 now states we make no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment, owe Fees only for Services ordered and actually used, and may reduce or terminate any Order Form under § 9.4. The comment flags the 12-month/30-day-notice/true-up fallback if Copperleaf needs some form of commitment.
